achievements.name: Opening Hour
achievements.detail: Clear Chapter 1, from Sissel's first moments as a ghost in the junkyard through the rescue.

achievements.name: A Curious Soul
achievements.detail: Hop from core to core until those jumps add up to four hundred forty-four.

achievements.name: Jumping Poltergeist
achievements.detail: Perform tricks on the things you possess until that tally hits four hundred forty-four.

achievements.name: Same, Same!
achievements.detail: After Missile can trade the places of nearby things, pull off that exchange forty-four times.

achievements.name: Secret Room
achievements.detail: Once Chapter 5's last reversal is locked in, carry the scene to its end while everyone stays alive.

achievements.name: Crimson Light
achievements.detail: Cross Chapter 9's red-lit exit route in a single clean attempt.

achievements.name: Too Much Medicine
achievements.detail: Settle Chapter 10's last reversal and finish that rescue with no one dying again.

achievements.name: Captive on the Roof
achievements.detail: From the Chapter 13 roof, connect with the aimed trick when you try it the second time.

achievements.name: Extraordinary Failure
achievements.detail: Throw Chapter 14 by steering the ball so Mino never receives it.

achievements.name: Red Light, Green Light
achievements.detail: Hold Chapter 15 together after its last reversal so the chapter ends with no new deaths.

achievements.name: Shifting Shape
achievements.detail: Finish the bonus puzzle board's entire five-by-five set.

achievements.name: Ghost Trick Master
achievements.detail: Tick off every optional challenge attached to the chapters.

achievements.name: Fate Averted
achievements.detail: See the final chapter through and let that long night end.
